current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether there exists an assignment of values 1, 2, or 3 to variables x, y, and z that satisfies all given
x != y, y != z, z != x, x + y + z = 4, x >= y, and y >= z.
IF solutions exist, ENUMERATE all such solutions.
IF no solutions exist, PROVIDE a minimal explanation of the conflicting constraints.

FILTER triples to keep only those where x >= y
FILTER triples to keep only those where y >= z
IF any triples remain THEN ENUMERATE all remaining triples as solutions
